name: 64110 · Kansas City, MO
findings: ZIP 64110 (Kansas City) has 170 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 62 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64110 (Kansas City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 64110 (Kansas City) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
